sloka: भरतस्यात्मजौ वीरौ तक्षः पुष्कल एव च ।मातुलेन सुगुप्तौ तु धर्मेण सुसमाहितौ ।। ७.१००.१६ ॥
transliteration: bharatasyātmajau vīrau takṣaḥ puṣkala eva ca ।mātulena suguptau tu dharmeṇa susamāhitau ।। 7.100.16 ॥

translations.english: These are Bharata's valiant sons, Taksha and Pushkala, who are well-protected by their maternal uncle and well-trained in righteousness.
translations.hindi: सत्यपराक्रमी श्रीरामचन्द्र जो भरत जी के यह अमृतमय जैसे वचन सुन कर, बहुत प्रसन्न हुए
